newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy household confidence index falls in June.
newsitem.headline: Italy household confidence index falls in June.

text.p: Confidence in the economy among Italian households fell in June amid renewed worries over price rises, economic research body Isco said.
Isco's latest monthly confidence index fell to 108.9 from 109.4 in May and compared with 117.9 in June 1996.
The survey of expectations for the economy over the next year showed increased pessimism, particularly over inflation, and households were also more worried about the jobs market.

But there were more positive signals about the personal economic situation of families, with a higher percentage of those polled foreseeing the possibility of putting aside savings over the next year.
Short-term buying intentions for durable goods were little changed on last month although the percentage of households planning to buy new homes was down slightly.
